definition.description: Retrieves the most recent service costs for a customer from Microsoft Partner Center API. Returns a list of line items with subscription details, charges, taxes, and invoice information.

inputFields.helpText: The unique identifier (GUID) of the customer in Partner Center.
Bearer token for Partner Center API authentication. Typically obtained from an OAuth node.

Number of unique subscriptions in the costs

The full raw JSON response body
